title: Quiz: TDD With AI Agents: Design the Tests First, Let the Agent Implement
description: Check your grasp of TDD with AI agents in Python. Write the contract and tests first, then let a coding agent implement code that passes them.
summary: In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of TDD With AI Agents: Design the Tests First, Let the Agent Implement . By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit how to define a contract, let an agent draft tests, harden those tests, fence them off while the agent implements, and review the resulting diff.
takeaways: These habits keep you in charge of the design while the agent does the typing, so you can trust the code it hands back.
